chapter_name: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
question_text: What influences the degree of centrifugal force on bends?
comment: The centrifugal force can throw your vehicle out of the curve. When doubling the speed, the centrifugal force quadruples. In addition, the curve radius influences this force as well. The tighter the curve, the more the centrifugal force increases. Therefore, you must brake early in tight corners.

chapter_name: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
question_text: Wet conditions can impair the effectiveness of drum brakes. What should you do?

options.text: I carefully drive to dry the brakes
I apply the brakes repeatedly while stationary

correct_answers.text: I carefully drive to dry the brakes

comment: The drum brake can run dry. For that you as the car driver brake cautiously. The drum brake heats up and the water can evaporate. Of course, you brake only when the traffic flow allows it. A rear-end collision must be avoided at all costs. Keep an eye on the traffic behind you.
